The '''Gmar Askilon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Krenhner sector/Legends|Krenhner sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Gmar Askilon]].
